capabilities: Filter tasks by date range, title keyword, tag, context, or manual selection
Generate report notes from selected tasks with an OpenAI-compatible model
Define reusable report templates with placeholders
Store API keys in Obsidian's SecretStorage
Configure model presets, output folder, date fields, and interface/report languages
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only reads tasks from TaskNotes and writes the generated report into a new note.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents network use in detail (task data and prompts go only to the configured endpoint, no telemetry), a migration caveat about cancelled statuses in TaskNotes, and includes a Chinese-language section. Requires Obsidian 1.12.2 or newer.
intentEvidence: This plugin reads tasks through TaskNotes' runtime API and does not modify it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a filtered set of tasks into a written summary report note.

relations.evidence: This plugin reads tasks through TaskNotes' runtime API and does not modify it.
